messages.subject: about plot in r
parts: I want to ask that how to draw a plot with two different y-axis but one x-axis? For example, one y-axis represent one parameter, from bottom to top the lowest to highest, while another y-axis represent another parameter, from top to bottom the lowest to highest. Thanks for your help.

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: about plot in r
parts:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/22701606/how-to-plot-bars-and-one-line-on-two-y-axes-in-the-same-chart-with-r-ggplot

It's not easy to do in ggplot2, because two-axis plots are somewhere
between not recommended and frowned upon in this particular part of
the statistical/quantitative graphics community ...
